contract.task_order: position then local_output_group; 3 outputs per task
contract.reduction: Cin/8 sequential input groups, 8 products per output per group
contract.input_bank: bank=ic%8,row=position*(Cin/8)+ic//8; depth 192 for Cin96, 384 for Cin192
contract.parameter_bank: 3 banks,row=local_oc//3; 8 rows for Cout24, 4 rows for Cout12
contract.concat_10_input: HWC channels are contiguous in frozen graph order: down4_bu.pw.conv then sppf.out.conv; no channel reorder
contract.numeric: signed33 every prefix; final INT32; cnn.integer exact RNE, Q7.8 SiLU, post INT8
contract.limits: fixed profiles only; 12-bit load addresses unchanged; no graph/global output writer
